_note: SHA-256 fingerprints of the leaf certificates, captured by scripts/recon/capture.py. mode=enforce means a mismatch aborts the run (the host's certificate cannot be validated any other way); mode=advisory means normal CA validation is authoritative and the pin is only logged, because the certificate is a real one that will rotate.

generacioncsr.celec.gob.ec:8443.subject: CN=*.celec.gob.ec, O=Corporacion Electrica del Ecuador Celec EP
generacioncsr.celec.gob.ec:8443.issuer: Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA OV R36
generacioncsr.celec.gob.ec:8443.notes: Valid Sectigo certificate since 2026-09-17; normal verification works, so no rejectUnauthorized override anywhere in the codebase.

smec.cenace.gob.ec:443.notes: Self-signed, expired in 2009, and only negotiates with DEFAULT@SECLEVEL=1. Chain validation is impossible, so the pin is the only identity check and a mismatch must fail the run.

www.cenace.gob.ec:443.notes: Valid leaf, but the server omits its intermediate; data/reference/tls/intermediates_www.cenace.gob.ec.pem (published in the leaf's AIA field) is appended to the trust store so normal verification succeeds.
